Title: Diagnosis
Details: The failing test `testReadingOfFirstStoredEntry` in `ZipArchiveInputStreamTest` seems to be reading a zip entry and asserting on its size and content. The current bug report mentions a discrepancy in the output between commons-compress 1.6 and 1.7 when reading the same zip file. In 1.7, the content of the zip entry seems to contain NUL bytes instead of the expected data. This suggests a potential issue with how zip entries are being read in commons-compress 1.7 compared to 1.6.

Looking at the test method, it creates a `ZipArchiveInputStream` by passing a file input stream of "COMPRESS-264.zip" to it, then reads the first zip entry and asserts on its size and content. The issue reported indicates that the content of the zip entry is not as expected when using commons-compress 1.7.

To diagnose the root cause, we need to investigate the changes or differences between commons-compress 1.6 and 1.7 that could lead to the observed behavior.

1. Get the implementation of the `ZipArchiveInputStream` constructor to understand how it handles zip entries differently in commons-compress 1.7 compared to 1.6.
2. Examine any changes related to zip entry reading logic in the commons-compress library between versions 1.6 and 1.7, focusing on how the content of zip entries is processed.
